name: Karos Razok
summary: At the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest, Karos Razok keeps the Forsaken bat roost ready.

sections.title: Keeper of the Sepulcher's Wings
sections.body: Karos Razok tends the skeletal bats from the wooden platform above the Sepulcher's crypts. Moonrage worgen, rogue Dalaran magi, and the human remnants of Ambermill make the northern road through Silverpine Forest treacherous. Razok keeps messengers, fresh recruits, and vital supplies moving above the haunted canopy, linking the frontier outpost to the capital in Tirisfal Glades.

aliases: who is the flight master in the sepulcher
faq.answer: Karos Razok tends the Forsaken bat roost at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. Horde travelers and messengers use the trained vampiric bats to cross Lordaeron.

faq.q: Where can Karos Razok send travelers?
aliases: where does the sepulcher bat fly
faq.answer: Karos Razok sends travelers from the Sepulcher to the Undercity in Tirisfal Glades and to Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills. His routes connect the outpost with northern Lordaeron.

aliases: what are the flying mounts at sepulcher
faq.answer: Karos Razok tends large, skeletal flight bats. These undead fliers are hardy and tireless, and the Forsaken favor them for their silence and endurance in Lordaeron's blighted skies.

faq.q: Why is a flight master important at the Sepulcher?
aliases: why is sepulcher bat master needed
faq.answer: Hostile forces make Silverpine's roads dangerous, from Pyrewood's worgen curse to the human wizards at Ambermill. Karos Razok gives the Forsaken an aerial route to supply the forward base without risking ambushes on the highway.

angles.text: As an Undead, you can use Karos Razok's bat roost to travel back to the Undercity, Lady Sylvanas's capital, from the Silverpine front.
As a Horde traveler heading south toward Hillsbrad Foothills, you can use Karos Razok's bat roost as a waypoint on Lordaeron's western edge.
